about: The SVG this renderer draws for the marks Mermaid 11 draws and it once drew plain or left out of the stylesheet: every sequence participant type and an actor's stick figure, every half, two-way, open, cross and central-connection message, a block frame, every flowchart shape with no bracket form, a fork turned in a left-to-right chart, a cylinder's outline, circle and cross heads, an invisible link, a subgraph title, the state start and end dots, and the lollipop ends of a class relations panel. Compared with Mermaid by shape class; these are the bytes.

cases.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant B@{ "type": "boundary" }
    participant C@{ "type": "control" }
    participant E@{ "type": "entity" }
    participant D@{ "type": "database" }
    participant L@{ "type": "collections" }
    participant Q@{ "type": "queue" }
    B-|\C: half-top
    C-|/E: half-bottom
    E-\\D: stick-top
    D-//L: stick-bottom
    L/|-Q: half-top-rev
    Q-|\L: half-top RtoL
    L//-D: stick-top-rev
    D<<->>E: both
    C<<-->>B: both dotted
    B()->>()C: central both
    C->>()D: central to
    D()->>E: central from
    Q->>Q: self
    Q/|-Q: self rev

cases.source:
sequenceDiagram
  actor U
  participant S
  U->S: open
  U-xS: cross
  loop again
    S-->>U: back
  end
  alt yes
    U->>S: a
  else no
    U->>S: b
  end

flowchart LR
  A[[sub]] --o B[(db)]
  B --x C@{ shape: fork }
  C ~~~ D
  subgraph G [Group]
    D
  end
